meta.name: Feels Like Ishq (Hindi Tv series 2021)
meta.description: Short films follow young adults as they navigate the gamut of emotions that come with finding romantic connection in unexpected places.

videos.title: Save the Da(y)te
videos.overview: While frantically searching for their runaway bride, a bridesmaid and a wedding planner with opposing takes on love and commitment banter and bicker

videos.title: Quaranteen Crush
videos.overview: Crushing on the girl self-quarantining next door, a teen tells seemingly innocent lies in order to meet her - but his charade may soon catch up to him.

videos.title: Star Host
videos.overview: A teen rents out his parents' holiday home to an unexpected solo traveler. But while the weekend begins on a sour note, it turns into one to remember.

videos.title: She Loves Me, She Loves Me Not
videos.overview: A closeted advertising associate falls for an out-and-proud colleague, but her subtle efforts to confess her feelings don't go quite as planned.

videos.title: Interview
videos.overview: Up for the same hob as a less qualified candidate, a woman agrees to give him interview tips, setting the stage for a rapport that goes beyond rivalry.

videos.title: Ishq Mastana
videos.overview: On a post-breakup rebound, a privileged teen goes on what he thinks is a casual date with a spirited activist who may change his views on love and life.
